arxiv-2109-06511.title: Geometric analysis of gaits and optimal control for three-link kinematic swimmers
arxiv-2109-06511.creator: Oren Wiezel, Suresh Ramasamy, Nathan Justus, Yizhar Or, Ross Hatton
arxiv-2109-06511.description: Abstract Many robotic systems locomote using gaits – periodic changes of internal shape, whose mechanical interaction with the robot’s environment generate characteristic net displacements. Prominent examples with two shape variables are the low Reynolds number 3-link “Purcell swimmer” with inputs of 2 joint angles and the “ideal fluid” swimmer.

arxiv-2207-11671.title: Physical Characterization of Early Galaxies in the Webb’s First Deep Field SMACS J0723.3 − - 7323 Journal: ApJL EaZY ( Brammer et al. 2008 ) , SExtractor ( Bertin & Arnouts 1996 , v2.25.0,) , gsf ( Morishita et al. 2018b ; Morishita et al. 2019 ) , fsps ( Conroy et al. 2009 )
arxiv-2207-11671.creator: T. Morishita, M. Stiavelli
arxiv-2207-11671.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by T. Morishita, M. Stiavelli. This paper highlights initial photometric analyses of JWST NIRCam imaging data in the sightline of SMACS0723, aiming to identify galaxies at redshift z > 7 z>7 . By applying a conservative Lyman-break selection followed by photometric redshift analysis and visual inspection, we identify four F090W-dropout and two F150W-dropout sources, three of which were recently confirmed in an independent spectroscopic analysis to z = 7.663 z=7.663 , 7.665, and 8.499.

arxiv-2210-10193.title: λ \lambda –MIMO: Massive MIMO via Modulo Sampling
arxiv-2210-10193.creator: Ziang Liu, Ayush Bhandari, and Bruno Clerckx
arxiv-2210-10193.description: Abstract Massive multiple-input multiple-output (M-MIMO) architecture is the workhorse of modern communication systems. Currently, two fundamental bottlenecks, namely, power consumption and receiver saturation, limit the full potential achievement of this technology. These bottlenecks are intricately linked with the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) used in each radio frequency (RF) chain.

arxiv-2409-00219.title: Higher categories of push-pull spans, II: Matrix factorizations
arxiv-2409-00219.creator: Lorenzo Riva
arxiv-2409-00219.description: Abstract . This is the second part of a project aimed at formalizing Rozansky-Witten models in the functorial field theory framework. In the first part we constructed a symmetric monoidal ( ∞ , 3 ) (\infty,3) -category 𝒞 ​ ℛ ​ 𝒲 \mathscr{CRW} of commutative Rozansky-Witten models with the goal of approximating the 3 3 -category of Kapustin and Rozansky.

arxiv-2409-04974.title: Platonic dynamical decoupling sequences for interacting spin systems
arxiv-2409-04974.creator: Colin Read, Eduardo Serrano-Ensástiga, John Martin
arxiv-2409-04974.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Colin Read, Eduardo Serrano-Ensástiga, John Martin. In the NISQ era, where quantum information processing is hindered by the decoherence and dissipation of elementary quantum systems, developing new protocols to extend the lifetime of quantum states is of considerable practical and theoretical importance.

arxiv-2508-05029.title: Theseus: A Distributed and Scalable GPU-Accelerated Query Processing Platform Optimized for Efficient Data Movement
arxiv-2508-05029.creator: Felipe Aramburú 1 William Malpica 1 Kaouther Abrougui 1 Amin Aramoon 1 Romulo Auccapuclla 1 Claude Brisson 1 Matthijs Brobbel 1 Colby Farrell 1 Pradeep Garigipati 1 Joost Hoozemans 1 Supun Kamburugamuve Akhil Nair 1 Alexander Ocsa 1 Johan Peltenburg 1 Rubén Quesada López 1 Deepak Sihag 1 Ahmet Uyar
arxiv-2508-05029.description: Abstract . Online analytical processing of queries on datasets in the many-terabyte range is only possible with costly distributed computing systems. To decrease the cost and increase the throughput, systems can leverage accelerators such as GPUs, which are now ubiquitous in the compute infrastructure.

arxiv-2508-08035.title: Analytical and numerical methods for spillover effects in prioritized PrEP for HIV prevention
arxiv-2508-08035.creator: Chiara Piazzola, Salman Safdar, Alex Viguerie, Abba B. Gumel
arxiv-2508-08035.description: Abstract Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is a highly effective intervention for preventing HIV transmission, but its high cost and uneven uptake raise key challenges for allocating resources efficiently. While spillover effects - wherein PrEP use in one group reduces infections in others-are known to occur, they remain poorly quantified and rarely guide policy.

arxiv-2509-24546.title: Nagare Media Engine: A System for Cloud- and Edge-Native Network-based Multimedia Workflows CCS: Networks Network architectures CCS: Information systems Multimedia streaming
arxiv-2509-24546.creator: Matthias Neugebauer
arxiv-2509-24546.description: Abstract . Before media playback is possible, live and video-on-demand content alike usually undergoes various operations described as tasks within a multimedia workflow. Where previously ingest, transcode, packaging and delivery tasks might have run on a single machine, today’s workflows are significantly more complex distributed systems. Describing and implementing multimedia workflows is challenging and requires new approaches.

pmc-11340140.title: VAIV bio-discovery service using transformer model and retrieval augmented generation
pmc-11340140.creator: Seonho Kim, Juntae Yoon
pmc-11340140.description: BackgroundThere has been a considerable advancement in AI technologies like LLM and machine learning to support biomedical knowledge discovery.Main bodyWe propose a novel biomedical neural search service called ‘VAIV Bio-Discovery’, which supports enhanced knowledge discovery and document search on unstructured text such as PubMed.

pmc-11430007.title: Enhancing Target Tracking: A Novel Grid-Based Beetle Antennae Search Algorithm and Confusion-Aware Detection
pmc-11430007.creator: Yixuan Lu, Chencong Ma, Dechao Chen
pmc-11430007.description: Unmanned aerial vehicle target tracking is a complex task that encounters challenges in scenarios involving limited computing resources, real-time requirements, and target confusion. This research builds on previous work and addresses challenges by proposing a grid-based beetle antennae search algorithm and designing a lightweight multi-target detection and positioning method, which integrates interference-sensing mechanisms and depth information.

pmc-12656851.title: Cytokine and Antibody Isotype Responses in Vaccinated Healthcare Workers with SARS-CoV-2 Breakthrough Infections
pmc-12656851.creator: Miguel Ángel Fernández-Rojas, Tanya Plett-Torres, Guillermina Ávila, Mirza Romero-Valdovinos, Ana María Salazar, Monserrat Sordo, Mariana Chávez-Vargas, Cesar Josué Coeto Ángeles, Mayra Cruz-Rivera, Carlos Santiago-Olivares, Juan Pablo Ramírez Hinojosa, Pablo Maravilla, Patricia Ostrosky-Wegman, Fel
pmc-12656851.description: Background: Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at high risk of breakthrough SARS-CoV-2 infections despite complete vaccination schedules. There are gaps in our understanding of the specific antibody isotypes and cytokine profiles produced during an infection following vaccination. In this study, we evaluated SARS-CoV-2−specific antibody isotypes and their association with cytokine production in HCWs with breakthrough infections.

pmc-12853982.title: FAM111B promotes prostate cancer progression by inhibiting apoptosis via ATF3 suppression and MAPK pathway activation: a novel biomarker and therapeutic target
pmc-12853982.creator: Yanan Wang, Zefeng Wang, Zhen Yin, Tianbao Song, Yipeng He, Ming Li, Zitao Wang, Zhongze Li, Peihan Wang, Zhiquan Hu, Zhihua Wang, Weimin Yu, Fan Cheng
pmc-12853982.description: BackgroundProstate cancer (PCa) ranks among the most prevalent and aggressive malignancies in men worldwide, with its incidence continuing to rise. This study investigates the role of FAM111B in PCa progression and evaluates its potential as both a biomarker and a therapeutic target.MethodsWe assessed FAM111B expression and function using in vitro and in vivo PCa models.

pmc-13439998.title: HeartSmart: development and evaluation of a culturally tailored, theory-based cardiovascular health promotion programme for university students in a North-Central Nigerian university — a quasi-experimental pre-post study
pmc-13439998.creator: Olasunkanmi Samson Coker, Edward A Omudu, Adamu Ishaku Akyala, Chukwu OO Chukwu, Regina Bolutife Coker, Awayimbo R Jaggu, Salako Ezekiel Oluseye, John Etim Edet
pmc-13439998.description: BackgroundCardiovascular disease (CVD) is the leading cause of mortality in sub-Saharan Africa, with hypertension as the primary modifiable risk factor. Despite a high and largely undetected hypertension burden, no culturally tailored, theory-based cardiovascular health promotion programme has been developed or evaluated for university students in North-Central Nigeria.

pmc-13454793.title: Isolation and characterization of two porcine circovirus type 2 strains from Heilongjiang Province and Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region
pmc-13454793.creator: Jintao Wang, Chun Lu, Guangqian Liu, Dongsong Guan, Yuan Shi, Mengyue Zhang, Zhishuan Ren
pmc-13454793.description: ImportancePorcine circovirus type 2 (PCV2) impairs the immune function in pigs and contributes to immunosuppressive disease, causing substantial economic losses worldwide.ObjectiveTo isolate and characterize PCV2 strains from two pig farms in China and evaluate pathogenicity in mice.MethodsLymph node tissues suspected of a PCV infection were collected from farms in Heilongjiang Province and Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

pmc-13584409.title: Risk of antidepressant-induced hyponatremia in geriatric patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13584409.creator: Yuan Zhang, Jin Zhang, Rui Jing
pmc-13584409.description: BackgroundHyponatremia is a frequent electrolyte disorder in clinical practice and is particularly prevalent among elderly populations. Antidepressants have been identified as an important pharmacological contributor. However, the event rate, overall risk, and differences across antidepressant classes remain incompletely characterized. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to quantify the event rate and comparative risk of antidepressant-induced hyponatremia in geriatric populations.
